status: INDICATIVE - compiled from news reports, NOT from an official BEST fare table. Verify at bestundertaking.com before relying on it.
as_of: Fare chart reported as effective 8 May 2025; later articles (2026) say BEST is considering restructuring, so it may have changed.
notes: Fares are charged per bus ticket (per leg); this tool adds legs together and does not model passes or any integrated ticketing.
The timetable feed does not say whether a bus is AC, so both columns are shown.
Real fares use BEST's route fare stages. We approximate ride distance by summing straight lines between stops (a lower bound) and widen the upper estimate by road_factor_high (an assumption).
Distances above 25 km are outside the reported table and are not priced.
Only BEST legs are priced. TMT, KDMT and VVMT use different fares that are not modelled.
